name: print-social-purple-calendar-new-year-greeting-post
title: Purple Calendar New Year Greeting
whatItIs: A portrait greeting post: a tilted grid-paper card with 'Happy New Year' (New Year in purple) and an illustration of a person at a monitor, laid over a deep purple calendar grid highlighting January 1.
whatItMeans: The calendar backdrop instantly says 'date' and adds a sense of a fresh start. Purple keeps it festive yet modern.
techniques: Highlight a single calendar cell as the theme
Tilted card layered on a large-scale grid
Flat vector illustration in the brand palette

vocabulary.definition: One grid or calendar cell emphasised in colour.
A pattern scaled so it is cropped and abstract.
A card tilted and placed over a separate background.
